# OpenSCAD browser runtime

Official OpenSCAD 2026.10.15 WebAssembly WEB snapshot, downloaded from:
https://files.openscad.org/snapshots/OpenSCAD-2026.10.15-WebAssembly-web.zip

Archive SHA-256 (verified against the official .sha256 file):
01fa89a1d67ac484508ecc8168e6fe16b9fbeeea1089caf753de4f0e5448d435

The JavaScript and WASM files are unmodified. COPYING contains the OpenSCAD GPL license.
Upstream source and build instructions: https://github.com/openscad/openscad
WebAssembly build project: https://github.com/openscad/openscad-wasm

This runtime is an experimental upstream build and is served locally with the app.
